name: Smile for Me
source:
Main character suddenly becomes an adventurer. But he does not know any magic or how to use a sword. But there are so many pretty girls around to drag about - he needs to try his best! 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然成为了一名冒险者。但他不会任何魔法，也不会用剑。但周围有这么多漂亮的女孩可以纠缠——他必须努力！

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
